content.short: EtherHub is an all-in-one crypto companion to swap, earn and claim, as a World and Base mini app.
content.description: EtherHub makes crypto simple for newcomers: users sign up with just an email, then swap tokens, earn and claim rewards in one place. It runs as a mini app in both World App and the Base App and is listed in World's ecosystem directory.
content.meta: EtherHub is an email-signup crypto app to swap, earn and claim, running as World and Base mini apps.
